event_text: Some Bell MTS customers say their email stopped working, per the Free Press
notes: Customer accounts only; start dates in the stories range from Nov 12 to Nov 18.

event_text: Bell says its Bell Canada breach happened; one Bell MTS customer tells CBC the last email arrived Tuesday night
notes: Date as given by Bell for the Bell Canada incident; no time stated.

event_text: Bell MTS posts on social media that some Manitoba customers may be experiencing an email service interruption
Bell MTS posts a follow-up telling customers to reset passwords and use webmail, per the Free Press
Bell MTS says email service is restored and customers may need to reset passwords
Bell MTS tells the Free Press a cyberattack on its email provider caused the outage; the story was posted at 6:11 PM ET
notes: Time is the story posting time; the statement time is not given.
